candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order to fail, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; root cause of the redis timeout (saturation, network, config) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out with DependencyUnavailable across all correlated checkout requests, propagating 503 from inventory and 502 at gateway checkout. Gateway metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2387ms) and 502s. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency.
